directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an advertisement on your campus website to sell a bicycle you used at college. Your advertisement may include its brand, features,condition and price, and your contact information. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
sample_essay:
Are you in search of a reliable and affordable bicycle for your campus commutes? Look no further! I'm selling my well-maintained college bicycle.

To begin with, this is a Forever brand bicycle, a well-known and trusted brand in the cycling industry. It features 26-inch wheels, which provide a smooth and stable ride on various campus terrains. The gears are adjustable, allowing you to easily switch between different speeds according to the road conditions. Whether you're going uphill or cruising on flat ground, this bike can meet your needs.

In addition, the condition of the bicycle is excellent. I've always taken good care of it. The frame is free of any major scratches or dents, and the brakes are in perfect working order, ensuring your safety while riding.

Moreover, the price is quite reasonable. I'm asking for only 200 yuan, which is a great deal considering the quality and condition of the bike.

If you're interested, please contact me at 123456789 via text or call. Don't miss this opportunity to own a great bicycle at a low price!
